selectedReferences.name: Dovetail
selectedReferences.role: Main research workspace and insight review
selectedReferences.pattern: Filterable chart + theme list + data points
selectedReferences.kind: Marketing page with a detailed embedded analytics view
selectedReferences.observed: One captured product view combines a research theme chart, a date range, a Themes / Data points switch, a count of selected themes and points, and a corresponding item list. Names connect the visualization to the underlying records.
selectedReferences.adapt: Use this pattern as the central Analyze workspace: compare result groups above, then keep the contributing runs and conditions in a linked table. Make the selected interval and number of included runs explicit. Treat the list as a route to inspect raw evidence.
selectedReferences.limit: Best overall reference for a research workspace, not a full simulation application. The captured product is for customer feedback; its revenue labels and dark grid do not transfer to cell biology. It does not show a setup or teaching flow.
selectedReferences.fit: Best overall for a researcher-facing overview that connects a chart to inspectable records.

method: Direct JSON-RPC MCP tools/list and tools/call. Five topical searches returned 50 result slots and 43 unique sites/screens after deduplication. Compared all 43 thumbnails, then inspected the 16 closest candidate captures at full-page resolution. Shortlisted nine references and retrieved three canonical React templates. Dovetail ranks first as the broadest research-workspace reference; the ranking is a reasoned design judgment, not a usability score. Site page sets are captured coverage, not verified journeys.
